purpose: Rules for provenance, separation, validation and model use of external aquaculture datasets.

rules.rule: Real-world observational datasets and synthetic datasets must remain separately identified.
Farm- or pond-level observations must not be blindly concatenated with aggregated annual statistics.
Every external dataset must retain provider, source, license and version or commit information.
Derived values must remain distinguishable from directly observed measurements.
Prediction features must not include observations occurring after the prediction cutoff or harvest event.
Dataset presence or benchmark performance must not be represented as proof of AquaLife real-world accuracy.
Third-party models or weights may only be redistributed or embedded when their applicable license permits it.
External validation data must not be silently reused as training data for the same evaluation.
